# Documentary collections

Scope: the collection_acceptance service contract in service_cases. This synthetic edition leaves other products unchanged. Monetary fields are integer minor units; 100 minor units equal one currency unit. Applicable account schedules and current external correspondence are available through the signed-in case.

Documentary collection is distinct from a documentary credit. D/P documents are deliverable after the full sight price has actually been paid, including a verified earlier payment. D/A documents are deliverable after the drawee has accepted the time bill. Acceptance creates a claim; it is not money in the wallet. The bank has no separate credit undertaking. Source correspondence states current receipts and acceptance.

Each action takes {record_id}. `post_receipt` posts the new D/P cash and associates verified historical payments with that collection. `register_acceptance` records a received D/A acceptance. `discount` requires an accepted, unassigned bill, transfers that bill once, and credits its face less the recorded fee; the future face cannot be collected again. `release_documents` performs the customer's manual delivery instruction and permanently records payment and acceptance at delivery. A manual release can be processed before commercial conditions are fulfilled; later payment does not change the earlier delivery record.

Service interface: `propose_collection_acceptance_instruction` takes {case_id, action, data}. Unlock it with unlock_discoverable_agent_tool, prepare the instruction with call_discoverable_agent_tool, obtain the customer's approval, then execute_request. The action-specific data fields above are exact. Failed execution rolls back atomically. See Trade Services account operations (TRADE-common) for source inquiries, ordinary obligations and logical updates.

Importing the same received acceptance again has no additional commercial effect. The bill still has one acceptance and may be discounted and delivered only once.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_collection_acceptance_instruction`

Documentary collections. Prepare one local action, subject to customer approval and bank execution. The service policy states the supported actions and their fields.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
